reviewer: Codex independent strict visual geometry review; not user final appearance approval

notes.routing_assessment: Usable as a high-density production-rebuild guide, but the visible semantic-detail quality does not honestly meet the written 2.5/3 visual-average threshold.
notes.eyes: One eye form per side with no ghost double. Both are shallow plaque-like pads, and the frontal pair differs in width and apparent depth.
notes.muzzle_and_cheeks: The broad muzzle and cheek volume tracks the canonical sheet well. Colored cheek marks were interpreted as raised plaques and should be replaced during the semantic rebuild.
notes.mouth: The closed V seam is continuous and not collapsed, but it is too deep and angular, with pinched dark endpoints. Do not preserve it as production lip topology.
notes.horns: All three primary horns are present and separated. The brow-horn pair differs visibly in length, lean, and base shape and should be rebuilt symmetrically.
notes.frill: Nine perimeter knobs are present and the frill silhouette is readable. Multiple knobs have annular or diagonal groove artifacts, uneven bulb shapes, and inconsistent junctions to the frill.
notes.hands: Three digits are visible on each hand in the frontal view. Their size and spacing are inconsistent, and some bases pinch or blend into one another.
notes.feet: Three toes are present on each foot. The viewer-left toes show longitudinal split or crease artifacts, and the bilateral toe volumes are noticeably unequal.
notes.tail: The tail has a clean continuous taper and upturned tip; its dorsal knob sequence remains readable.
notes.macro_integrity: No detached large parts, severe whole-body asymmetry, collapsed form, or melted major silhouette was observed.
notes.machine_context: The evaluator reports one watertight connected mesh at 1,974,918 triangles with no boundary, non-manifold, loose, or degenerate elements.
